1.

Praise the Lord, all saints! Joyfully before Him we bow down And call upon His precious name, Who is risen!

2.

Jesus, Thou hast become our all, Thou, who fought the sore conflict, Won for us the deep peace, Which we here enjoy.

3.

God in Thee has found His rest, And the precious blood that flowed Has won for us reconciliation; To Thee be eternal praise!

4.

Lord, keep us by Thy side, Help us ever to await Thee, Joyfully in hope to suffer with Thee During our waiting here!

5.

Thou, our life, shalt be manifested, We shall see Thee and be glorified, As Thy bride with joy be received Into Thy Father’s house.
